user.title: ANP Postos
user.description: ANP fuel stations (ANP Com Vc - Postos) on the map, with irregular-station alerts.

data.fetch_details: Fetch inspections and samples for irregular stations

data_description.cities: Cities whose ANP-authorized stations go on the map.
data_description.max_nota: ANP scores 0-5 based on violations and non-conforming samples. Stations at or below this score, interdicted or not operating are irregular and trigger a notification.
data_description.notify_services: Besides the persistent notification, also send through these services (e.g. notify.mobile_app_iphone).
data_description.scan_interval_hours: ANP refreshes data a few times per week.
data_description.fetch_details: Inspection history, violations, samples, products and fuel origin.
